column1: # astro_rules.tsv - user-supplied Horn rule table for the SBC ontology.
# These rules are the video claims' rule language, carried as ASSUMPTIONS
# and not facts: every derivation they produce carries the verdict
# Format (tab separated): rule_id, then each premise as 3 fields
# (subject, predicate, object), then the conclusion as 3 fields.
# "?name" binds variables across premises and the conclusion.
